drafted_from: tool:judge-sound-effect-candidates-and-pick-one-per-sound row in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/ and tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (run for real on made-up tones)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Judge the hit candidates in /work/sfx against my palette and pick one per sound." It builds REQUEST.json for sound hit (query "a low hit"), runs the judge with the Python that has earshot and tells you which candidate won.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads sound files and a REQUEST.json on this computer and writes its own score and selection files.
instructions: 1. Put your candidate sounds in folders (for example /work/sfx/forge/hit-impact/*.wav and /work/sfx/gen/model/hit/*.wav) and your real palette sound in /work/sfx/palette/hit.wav.

2. Write /work/sfx/request.json with sounds [{name, query}], palette {rate, channels, fade_in_s, fade_out_s, peak_dbfs}, reference_folder, candidates {generator: glob}, candidates_folder, picked_folder, scores and selection.

3. Say "Judge my sound candidates". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: EARSHOT_THREADS=3 <earshot python> -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/judge_sound_effects.py /work/sfx/request.json (add sound names after it to judge only those).

4. Read the last line: result.picks names each sound, the generator that won and its match z; the picked WAV sits in picked_folder, leveled to the real sound. An error line names the sound with no clean candidate.

worked_examples.title: Two forged hits and one distorted generated hit: the low forged one wins
worked_examples.ask: Judge the hit candidates and pick the best one.
worked_examples.given: From tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (test_picks_the_best_match_that_is_not_distorted_and_levels_it_to_the_reference, stand-in earshot): request.json asks sound "hit" with query "a low hit"; candidates are forge impact_01.wav (200 Hz tone), impact_02.wav (2000 Hz), a clipped 200 Hz model file p0-s1.wav and a 210 Hz model file p0-s2.wav; max_saturated 0.001, least_build 0.8. Command: EARSHOT_THREADS=3 python -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/judge_sound_effects.py /work/sfx/request.json
worked_examples.hands_back: Last line: {"result": {"selection": "/work/sfx/selection.json", "picks": {"hit": {"generator": "forge", "match_z": 3.0}}}}. selection.json holds hit with source /work/sfx/forge/hit-impact/impact_01.wav; candidates.json holds 4 rows (the clipped one has saturated_frac above 0.001, so it cannot be picked); picked/hit.wav is 48000 Hz, 2 channels, at the real palette sound's active loudness.
